name: hollow-chess-app
description: Hollow Chess for Android and iOS. Wraps the website's own files, so the game, accounts and database are shared with hollowchess.com.

scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
